chunks: She said: 'How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor am I sinful?'

key_terms.بَغِيًّا: Sexually immoral or concubine; one who commits zina or is a concubine
key_terms.يَمْسَسْنِي: Touched me; specifically referring to sexual contact

ai.seo_question: What did Maryam say to explain her miraculous pregnancy?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Maryam’s (peace be upon her) spiritual purity (‘Adhrah) and her status as a chosen woman, affirming that her miraculous conception was a divine sign rather than a biological anomaly. It serves as a foundational proof for the virgin birth of Isa (Jesus), emphasizing God’s power to create without a father, a concept central to both Islamic and Christian theological discussions on prophetic miracles.
